post /s/{space_id}/api/security_ai_assistant/current_user/conversations
Refer to [Spaces](https://www.elastic.co/docs/deploy-manage/manage-spaces) for more information. Create a new Security AI Assistant conversation. This endpoint allows the user to initiate a conversation with the Security AI Assistant by providing the required parameters.

**Spaces method and path for this operation:**
delete /s/{space_id}/api/security_ai_assistant/current_user/conversations
Refer to [Spaces](https://www.elastic.co/docs/deploy-manage/manage-spaces) for more information. This endpoint allows users to permanently delete all conversations.

params.name: fields
params.description: A list of fields to include in the response. If omitted, all fields are returned.

params.name: filter
params.description: A search query to filter the conversations. Can match against titles, messages, or other conversation attributes.

params.name: sort_field
params.description: The field by which to sort the results. Valid fields are `created_at`, `title`, and `updated_at`.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: The order in which to sort the results. Can be either `asc` for ascending or `desc` for descending.

params.name: page
params.description: The page number of the results to retrieve. Default is 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of conversations to return per page. Default is 20.

params.name: is_owner
params.description: Whether to return conversations that the current user owns. If true, only conversations owned by the user are returned.
